prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kidōmaru, the formidable Japanese oni youth who breaks rope and metal chains.
ANATOMY: ONE formidable large ADULT-LOOKING YOUTH, one head, two natural dark eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs; fierce weathered youthful face, long disordered dark hair, NO invented horns/tusks/extra eyes. Fully opaque dark cloth tunic and trousers beneath an INTACT coarse brown-and-ivory COW-HIDE mantle, no animal head, hooves, carcass or wounds [kidomaru-c06,kidomaru-c13,kidomaru-c15].
MOMENT: Burst out of a shadowed stable doorway toward viewer, wrench his two bound wrists APART so a METAL CHAIN snaps at one clear link and a thick ROPE frays apart, metal fragments fall physically and taut rope fibres separate. Hands clenched, elbows wide, eyes glaring down toward viewer, one boot plants in snow.
POWER: documented physical strength breaking his binding rope and metal chain; NO glow, beams or aura [kidomaru-c03,kidomaru-c11].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle; intense face, two wrist cuffs, snapped chain and cowhide mantle dominate square. Human youth scale, not invented giant, doorway reference behind.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single warm lantern from doorway rakes face and flying broken iron link, deep walnut shadows against cold snow; ordinary blown snow and breath.
SURFACE: rough intact cow hide, thick rope fibres, rusty chain, coarse opaque clothing, wet dark hair, compacted snow.
SETTING: editorial snow-covered stable doorway, using documented cowhide-in-snow motif [kidomaru-c06].
MOOD: dangerous imposing legendary strength in decisive escape, never ordinary relaxed man, moviehero, cute or decorative. No other people, weapons, animal injury, blood or gore.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
name: Kidōmaru
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one formidable young adult with one head/two eyes/two arms/two legs, opaque clothing and intact cowhide mantle; no horns/carcass invented. Wrists pull apart snapping metal chain and fraying rope, falling physical fragments, boot steps into snow. Face and chainbreak dominate at 200px, clearly legendary strength rather than ordinary man. No text, glow, weapons, victims or gore. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, both-fist crops and a leg/boot crop. One formidable large youth (kidomaru-c11/c13, 'though human' c19): one head, two glaring eyes, two arms ending in clenched five-finger fists with thumbs visible, and two legs (front boot plunging into snow, rear boot behind). Opaque dark tunic and trousers, with an intact coarse brown-and-ivory cow-hide mantle and no animal head or carcass (Sekien's cowhide-in-snow, c06). He bursts from a lantern-lit stable doorway (bound in the stable, c10) and wrenches his iron-cuffed wrists apart: the rusty chain snaps at the centre with link fragments falling, and the thick rope frays (breaks rope and metal chain, c03/c11). Extreme low angle, snow and hay, a fierce downward glare. A legendary feat of strength, not an ordinary man, and it reads at 200px. No invented horns, weapons, victims, gore, text or aura.
